market_outlook.short_term: Volatile and risk-off. CPI data today is the pivotal catalyst — a hot print triggers Fed hike expectations, pushing yields higher and pressuring equities. Oil at $108 with Houthi escalation creates upside risk. Diesel at $6/gallon is a leading indicator of consumer pain. Expect 3-5% equity volatility in coming weeks. Credit markets showing haven bid (French inversion) despite rising yields — a paradox signaling stress. Bitcoin below $77K and silver negative reflect risk-off rotation.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but bifurcated. AI capex cycle (Nvidia, Oracle, Alibaba) supports tech leadership but governance/safety concerns create regulatory overhang. Housing may stabilize within 12-18 months (Abel's thesis). Higher rates become structural, favoring financials and dividend payers. BRICS realignment and Iran uncertainty create a 2-3 year geopolitical risk premium. Energy transition (solar without storage) remains a structural gap. Consumer recovery is selective, not broad-based.
